capabilities: Style selected text with color, highlight, size, font, and bold/italic as inline HTML spans
Align or indent paragraphs, table cells, and image embeds
Insert symbols from a searchable character picker
Restyle or clear formatting on existing spans, including partial selections
Rename, recolor, add, or remove every toolbar preset in the settings tab
extras: README documents Obsidian limitations: markdown inside inline HTML shows as raw text in Editing view, and image alignment reverts if the plugin is uninstalled because it relies on the plugin's CSS. Output is plain inline HTML that keeps rendering after removal.
motivation: The author built it to avoid the conflicts of mixing formatting syntaxes by keeping all styling in a single layer of plain inline HTML.
problem: Markdown and HTML styling from different plugins nest unpredictably and conflict, producing locked colors, un-colorable bold, and broken nested tags.

relations.evidence: sister plugins, built by the same author to the same house style and designed to work side by side

summary: Floating formatting toolbar that applies color, highlight, size, font, bold/italic, alignment, and indent as one merged inline HTML span.
